title: 三峽升船機~Three Gorges ship lift
focus: 高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界~Counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson
summary: 本課以三峽升船機為入口，深入高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Three Gorges ship lift as its entry point, this course examines counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 提升功率敏感度固定速度0.2 m/s與g=9.81 m/s²，只將不平衡質量由100 t降至50 t。純重力功率Δmgv由196.2降至98.1 kW，減少50%；這只是相同速度下需克服的重力項。摩擦、啟停加速度、再生回送和傳動效率仍須另計，不能因此宣稱整機耗電也減半。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For lifting-power sensitivity, hold speed at 0.2 m/s and g at 9.81 m/s², reducing only imbalance mass from 100 t to 50 t. Gravity-only power Δmgv falls from 196.2 to 98.1 kW, a 50% reduction in that component. Friction, starting acceleration, regeneration and drive efficiency remain separate, so total machine electricity consumption need not halve.
history: 三峽升船機採用齒輪齒條提升和配重系統，公開資料可用來辨認長行程船廂的多點同步與高程銜接問題。十月升船機續建工程恢復施工，後續進行設備安裝與整合。 九月十八日開始試通航，與後續正式竣工驗收區分。 十二月二十七日竣工驗收，形成工程階段的另一里程碑。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~The Three Gorges ship lift uses rack-and-pinion lifting with counterweights, providing public context for multi-point synchronization and docking over a long vertical travel. Ship-lift construction resumes in October before subsequent installation and integration. Trial navigation begins on September eighteen, distinct from later completion acceptance. Completion acceptance occurs on December twenty-seven as a separate project milestone. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 船舶排水與船廂質量~Vessel displacement and caisson mass
units.title: 船舶排水與船廂質量~Vessel displacement and caisson mass
units.mechanism: 浮船進入保持固定水位的船廂時，會排出等重的水，因此船加水總重近似不變。這個平衡依賴船舶自由浮動及水量能夠交換，不能套用坐底或封閉增水情況。 假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。 船舶坐底後不再完整由浮力支承，水位改變也會破壞固定總重假設。若混淆載貨重量和船舶總排水質量，平衡重判讀將出現大幅偏差。~A floating vessel entering a fixed-level caisson displaces water of equal weight, keeping vessel-plus-water mass approximately constant. This requires free flotation and water exchange, and does not apply to grounding or added water in a sealed chamber. Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Grounding removes full buoyant support, while changing level breaks constant total mass. Confusing cargo weight with total vessel displacement can cause a large error in interpreting counterweight balance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes.
units.verify: 用進出船前後水位、船舶排水資料與交換水量交叉核對，不使用載重噸代替排水量；另記錄繫纜是否向船廂施加豎向分力。確認船體仍有底部淨空，並以水位變化推算是否真的排出與船重相等的水量。~Cross-check pre-entry and post-entry levels, vessel displacement and exchanged water. Do not substitute deadweight for displacement, and record whether moorings apply vertical forces to the caisson. Confirm under-keel clearance and use level change to verify that exchanged water actually matches the vessel displacement mass.
units.failure: 船舶坐底後不再完整由浮力支承，水位改變也會破壞固定總重假設。若混淆載貨重量和船舶總排水質量，平衡重判讀將出現大幅偏差。~Grounding removes full buoyant support, while changing level breaks constant total mass. Confusing cargo weight with total vessel displacement can cause a large error in interpreting counterweight balance.
units.misconception: 船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。~A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass.
units.practice: 以船舶排水與船廂質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用進出船前後水位、船舶排水資料與交換水量交叉核對，不使用載重噸代替排水量；另記錄繫纜是否向船廂施加豎向分力。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for vessel displacement and caisson mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Cross-check pre-entry and post-entry levels, vessel displacement and exchanged water. Do not substitute deadweight for displacement, and record whether moorings apply vertical forces to the caisson.

units.anchor: 配重不平衡功率~Counterweight imbalance power
units.title: 配重不平衡功率~Counterweight imbalance power
units.mechanism: 配重抵銷大部分重力，但驅動仍需克服不平衡、摩擦與加速度。把整個提升重量乘高度當成電力耗用，會忽略下降配重釋放的位能。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。 配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。~Counterweights offset most gravity, but drives still overcome imbalance, friction and acceleration. Multiplying total lifted weight by height overstates electrical demand by ignoring potential energy released by descending counterweights. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power. Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power.
units.verify: 同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。將上升與下降的功率差分離為重力項，核對摩擦估計是否維持合理的非負耗能。~Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration. Compare opposite directions under matched conditions and avoid interpreting regenerated electricity as negative friction. Separate gravitational demand from opposite-direction power differences and check that inferred friction remains a plausible nonnegative loss.
units.failure: 配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。~Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant.
units.misconception: 有配重就能完全消除所有重力差所需的驅動功率。~Counterweights completely eliminate drive power required by every gravitational imbalance.
units.practice: 以配重不平衡功率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for counterweight imbalance power, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration. Compare opposite directions under matched conditions and avoid interpreting regenerated electricity as negative friction.

units.anchor: 齒條切向力分配~Rack tangential-force sharing
units.title: 齒條切向力分配~Rack tangential-force sharing
units.mechanism: 齒輪齒條把轉矩轉成豎向力，多驅動點必須協調分擔。平均轉矩相同不保證齒面接觸相同，幾何誤差和傳動剛度會造成局部偏載。 假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。 一個驅動點遲滯會使其他點先承載，扭矩平均值可能仍正常。齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。~Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points. Equal mean torque does not ensure equal tooth contact because geometric error and drivetrain stiffness create local unequal loading. Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m. Tangential force T/r=400 kN, an ideal contact resultant excluding tooth-root stress concentration. A lagging drive shifts load to other points despite an apparently normal mean torque. Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m. Tangential force T/r=400 kN, an ideal contact resultant excluding tooth-root stress concentration.
units.verify: 對照軸扭矩、齒條位移及接觸印痕，核查各驅動點的相位與幾何校準；把單齒接觸和多齒分擔的假設寫入局部強度模型。由齒輪節圓半徑反算切向力，核對不同接觸齒數假設對局部齒根需求的敏感度。~Compare shaft torque, rack displacement and contact patterns, checking phase and geometric calibration at each drive. State single-tooth versus multiple-tooth sharing assumptions in the local strength model. Infer tangential force from pitch radius and test how assumed contact-tooth count affects local tooth-root demand.
units.failure: 一個驅動點遲滯會使其他點先承載，扭矩平均值可能仍正常。齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。~A lagging drive shifts load to other points despite an apparently normal mean torque. Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms.
units.misconception: 平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。~Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth.
units.practice: 以齒條切向力分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照軸扭矩、齒條位移及接觸印痕，核查各驅動點的相位與幾何校準；把單齒接觸和多齒分擔的假設寫入局部強度模型。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rack tangential-force sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare shaft torque, rack displacement and contact patterns, checking phase and geometric calibration at each drive. State single-tooth versus multiple-tooth sharing assumptions in the local strength model.

units.anchor: 四角同步與船廂傾斜~Corner synchronization and caisson tilt
units.title: 四角同步與船廂傾斜~Corner synchronization and caisson tilt
units.mechanism: 大型船廂由多點支承，位置差會轉成傾斜與扭曲，進而改變導向和對接條件。同步控制須比較同基準位置，不能只比較各馬達轉速。 假設橫向支承跨20 m、兩側高差4 mm，小角度θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad，即0.01146°；剛體近似不含扭曲。 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。~A caisson supported at several points converts position differences into tilt and distortion, affecting guidance and docking. Synchronization requires common-reference positions rather than motor speeds alone. Assume transverse support spacing 20 m and level difference 4 mm. Small-angle θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad, or 0.01146 degrees, for rigid motion without distortion. Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設橫向支承跨20 m、兩側高差4 mm，小角度θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad，即0.01146°；剛體近似不含扭曲。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume transverse support spacing 20 m and level difference 4 mm. Small-angle θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad, or 0.01146 degrees, for rigid motion without distortion.
units.verify: 用獨立測量基準核對多點編碼器與傾角計，分離剛體傾斜和船廂撓曲；記錄同步誤差隨高度與方向的變化，找出重複性模式。使用四角位移擬合平面後檢查殘差，將剛體傾斜和結構扭曲以不同指標記錄。~Check encoders and inclinometers against independent survey references, separating rigid tilt from caisson bending. Track synchronization error against elevation and direction to identify repeatable patterns. Fit a plane to corner displacements and examine residuals, recording rigid tilt separately from structural distortion.
units.failure: 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。~Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components.
units.misconception: 所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。~Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized.
units.practice: 以四角同步與船廂傾斜編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用獨立測量基準核對多點編碼器與傾角計，分離剛體傾斜和船廂撓曲；記錄同步誤差隨高度與方向的變化，找出重複性模式。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for corner synchronization and caisson tilt, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check encoders and inclinometers against independent survey references, separating rigid tilt from caisson bending. Track synchronization error against elevation and direction to identify repeatable patterns.

units.anchor: 鋼索彈伸與溫度~Rope extension and temperature
units.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度~Rope extension and temperature
units.mechanism: 鋼索受力會伸長，等長索因有效剛度和溫度差也可能產生不同位移。鋼索等效模數與實心鋼棒不同，必須使用實測或供應者資料。 假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。 端接滑移可能表現為長度增加卻不符合索力變化，斷絲也會降低有效剛度。若把所有延伸都視為可逆彈性，便會漏掉需獨立檢查的損傷。~Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature. Rope effective modulus differs from a solid steel bar and requires measured or supplier-supported values. Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Anchorage slip produces extension inconsistent with tension, and broken wires reduce effective stiffness. Treating all elongation as reversible elasticity misses damage that requires an independent physical inspection.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep.
units.verify: 同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。在相似索力與溫度下比較長期長度，檢查不可回復部分是否集中於特定端接。~Record tension, reference length and temperature together, separating elastic from permanent extension. Check strand construction, anchorage slip and modulus definition instead of using nominal solid-steel elasticity. Compare long-term lengths at matched tension and temperature and identify whether irreversible extension concentrates at particular terminations.
units.failure: 端接滑移可能表現為長度增加卻不符合索力變化，斷絲也會降低有效剛度。若把所有延伸都視為可逆彈性，便會漏掉需獨立檢查的損傷。~Anchorage slip produces extension inconsistent with tension, and broken wires reduce effective stiffness. Treating all elongation as reversible elasticity misses damage that requires an independent physical inspection.
units.misconception: 鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。~A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
units.practice: 以鋼索彈伸與溫度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rope extension and temperature, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record tension, reference length and temperature together, separating elastic from permanent extension. Check strand construction, anchorage slip and modulus definition instead of using nominal solid-steel elasticity.

units.anchor: 螺旋機構自鎖判讀~Self-locking of screw mechanisms
units.title: 螺旋機構自鎖判讀~Self-locking of screw mechanisms
units.mechanism: 螺旋升降或安全機構的自鎖與導程角、摩擦和牙型有關。靜態幾何比較可解釋反驅趨勢，不能替代實際安全裝置的設計和動態試驗。 假設理想方牙螺旋導程角3°、摩擦係數0.08，tan3°=0.0524小於0.08，靜態模型有自鎖趨勢；未含振動、潤滑變動與其他牙型。 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。~Screw self-locking depends on lead angle, friction and thread form. A static geometric comparison explains back-driving tendency without replacing the design and dynamic verification of a real safety mechanism. Assume an ideal square thread with lead angle three degrees and friction coefficient 0.08. tan3°=0.0524 below 0.08 suggests static self-locking, excluding vibration, lubrication change and other thread forms. Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理想方牙螺旋導程角3°、摩擦係數0.08，tan3°=0.0524小於0.08，靜態模型有自鎖趨勢；未含振動、潤滑變動與其他牙型。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an ideal square thread with lead angle three degrees and friction coefficient 0.08. tan3°=0.0524 below 0.08 suggests static self-locking, excluding vibration, lubrication change and other thread forms.
units.verify: 核對實際牙型、摩擦試驗和潤滑狀況，將靜態判讀與獨立制動功能分開；在工程文件中追蹤哪些結論來自理論，哪些已有設備驗證。對摩擦係數作上下界分析，確認導程角比較的結論是否依賴單一未驗證摩擦值。~Check actual thread form, friction testing and lubrication, separating static interpretation from independent braking functions. Track which conclusions are theoretical and which have equipment-specific verification. Bound the friction coefficient and determine whether the lead-angle conclusion depends on one unverified friction value.
units.failure: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。~Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism.
units.misconception: 螺旋機構具有靜態自鎖就保證所有動態情況安全。~Static screw self-locking guarantees safety under every dynamic condition.
units.practice: 以螺旋機構自鎖判讀編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對實際牙型、摩擦試驗和潤滑狀況，將靜態判讀與獨立制動功能分開；在工程文件中追蹤哪些結論來自理論，哪些已有設備驗證。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for self-locking of screw mechanisms, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check actual thread form, friction testing and lubrication, separating static interpretation from independent braking functions. Track which conclusions are theoretical and which have equipment-specific verification.

units.anchor: 對接水位差作用~Docking head-difference force
units.title: 對接水位差作用~Docking head-difference force
units.mechanism: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。對接荷載需區分平衡水位、間隙充水和結構鎖定，不可只憑水面看似齊平。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。~Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. Docking assessment separates equalized levels, gap filling and structural restraint instead of relying on water surfaces that merely appear aligned. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area. Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area.
units.verify: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。將兩側水位差直接換算壓差，核對間隙充水過程的荷載峰值是否符合量測。~Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value. Convert the two-sided level difference directly to pressure and check whether measured peaks match the gap-filling stage.
units.failure: 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。~Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself.
units.misconception: 肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。~Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
units.practice: 以對接水位差作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking head-difference force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value.

units.anchor: 啟停加速度與慣性~Start-stop acceleration and inertia
units.title: 啟停加速度與慣性~Start-stop acceleration and inertia
units.mechanism: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。加速時兩者動能同時增加，不能將淨重量小誤當總慣性小。 假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。~Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. Both gain kinetic energy during acceleration, so small net weight does not imply small total inertial demand. Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia. Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia.
units.verify: 從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。以能量增量獨立核對加速功，確認配重和傳動旋轉件沒有從總慣性中遺漏。~Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms. Independently check acceleration work from energy increase and verify that counterweights and rotating drivetrain inertia are not omitted.
units.failure: 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。~Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction.
units.misconception: 配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。~Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
units.practice: 以啟停加速度與慣性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for start-stop acceleration and inertia, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms.

units.anchor: 塔柱溫度與對中~Tower temperature and alignment
units.title: 塔柱溫度與對中~Tower temperature and alignment
units.mechanism: 高塔受日照與季節溫度變化會伸縮，導軌相對位置因此改變。均勻伸長和橫向溫差彎曲是不同機制，應用獨立幾何量測辨認。 假設有效塔高120 m、混凝土熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻升溫10 K，伸長αLΔT=12 mm；不含溫差彎曲與徐變。 日照不均造成的彎曲可能比平均溫升更影響導向，測站自身也會熱變形。若把可逆日變化當永久沉降，可能誤導對中診斷和維護優先次序。~Tall towers expand with solar and seasonal temperature changes, shifting guide alignment. Uniform extension differs from curvature caused by transverse thermal gradients and requires independent geometric observations. Assume effective tower height 120 m, concrete thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K and uniform warming 10 K. Extension αLΔT=12 mm, excluding thermal curvature and creep. Uneven solar heating can affect guidance more than mean warming, and survey stations can also deform thermally. Mistaking reversible daily movement for settlement misdirects alignment diagnosis and maintenance priorities.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效塔高120 m、混凝土熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻升溫10 K，伸長αLΔT=12 mm；不含溫差彎曲與徐變。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective tower height 120 m, concrete thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K and uniform warming 10 K. Extension αLΔT=12 mm, excluding thermal curvature and creep.
units.verify: 把塔柱不同方位溫度、測量基準和導軌位置同步，分離日循環與長期沉降；在相似溫度條件下比較年度幾何，而非直接比較任意兩天。將左右塔柱日變形與日照方向對照，檢查固定參考點本身是否存在溫度相關位移。~Synchronize temperatures on different faces, survey references and rail positions. Separate daily cycles from long-term settlement and compare annual geometry at similar thermal conditions rather than arbitrary dates. Compare daily tower movement with solar orientation and check whether nominal reference points themselves move with temperature.
units.failure: 日照不均造成的彎曲可能比平均溫升更影響導向，測站自身也會熱變形。若把可逆日變化當永久沉降，可能誤導對中診斷和維護優先次序。~Uneven solar heating can affect guidance more than mean warming, and survey stations can also deform thermally. Mistaking reversible daily movement for settlement misdirects alignment diagnosis and maintenance priorities.
units.misconception: 單一平均塔柱溫度足以描述所有熱變形和對中變化。~One mean tower temperature describes all thermal deformation and alignment changes.
units.practice: 以塔柱溫度與對中編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把塔柱不同方位溫度、測量基準和導軌位置同步，分離日循環與長期沉降；在相似溫度條件下比較年度幾何，而非直接比較任意兩天。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tower temperature and alignment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Synchronize temperatures on different faces, survey references and rail positions. Separate daily cycles from long-term settlement and compare annual geometry at similar thermal conditions rather than arbitrary dates.

units.anchor: 全流程時間與容量~Full-cycle time and capacity
units.title: 全流程時間與容量~Full-cycle time and capacity
units.mechanism: 提升速度只決定垂直運動的一段時間，通航能力還包含進出船、對接與確認。以單程升降時間推算每日通過量，會高估系統容量。 假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。~Lift speed controls only the vertical-motion portion of a transit. Entry, exit, docking and confirmation also consume time, so movement time alone overstates daily system capacity. Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed. Adding 1300 s for entry, exit and docking gives 1800 s and ideal two cycles per hour, excluding outages. Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. Using the fastest transit as annual performance hides queues and availability differences.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed. Adding 1300 s for entry, exit and docking gives 1800 s and ideal two cycles per hour, excluding outages.
units.verify: 按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。把每循環最長串聯作業時間加總，並確認每小時容量沒有把必要確認程序當成重疊。~Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability. Sum the longest sequential activities per cycle and ensure hourly capacity does not treat necessary confirmations as overlapping.
units.failure: 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。~Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. Using the fastest transit as annual performance hides queues and availability differences.
units.misconception: 提升速度最快的設備必定具有最大的全年通航量。~The fastest lifting equipment necessarily has the greatest annual throughput.
units.practice: 以全流程時間與容量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle time and capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability.

facts: 官方最大提升高度113 m。~The official maximum lift is 113 m.
官方船廂含水提升重量約15500 t。~Official lifted caisson mass including water is approximately 15500 t.
教學2000 t浮船排開2000 m³淡水。~A teaching 2000 t floating vessel displaces 2000 m³ freshwater.
教學100 t不平衡在0.2 m/s需196.2 kW重力功率。~Teaching imbalance 100 t at 0.2 m/s requires gravity power 196.2 kW.
教學20 m支距高差4 mm相當0.0002 rad。~Teaching 4 mm difference over 20 m spacing equals 0.0002 rad.
教學船廂與配重慣性力為150 kN。~The teaching caisson-counterweight inertial force is 150 kN.
